program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (filter (lambda (p)
                (or (= (first p) r0) (= (first p) r1)
                    (= (second p) c0) (= (second p) c1)))
              (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1)))
    (define (hollow-rect? obj)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
        (and (>= (- (third bb) (first bb)) 2)
             (>= (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 2)
             (equal? (sort (obj-cells obj) cell<?)
                     (sort (rect-border (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)) cell<?)))))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 4) (hollow-rect? o))) (objects g 0))])
      (let* ((inside (bbox-interior-cells obj))
             (markers (filter (lambda (p)
                                (let ((v (at g (first p) (second p))))
                                  (and (not (= v 0)) (not (= v 4)))))
                              inside)))
        (if (= (length (remove-duplicates (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) markers))) 1)
            (let ((fill (at g (first (first markers)) (second (first markers)))))
              (foldl (lambda (p acc)
                       (if (= (at acc (first p) (second p)) 0)
                           (set-cell acc (first p) (second p) fill)
                           acc))
                     out inside))
            out)))))
